answer: Standing decays sharply after 3 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The fable decay curve is applied at each close, nadir records the drop, and thread recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. Repeating the trick 28 times costs 52 separate deposits and 6 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
